actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

dimensions.assessment: Applies to AI developers, cloud providers, covered deployers with large user bases, and US consumers.
dimensions.evidence: not fewer than 1,000,000 unique monthly users in the United States

dimensions.assessment: Requires extensive public disclosures, safety evaluations, and compliance documentation for covered AI systems.
dimensions.evidence: requiring each developer of a covered model... to make publicly available the information described

dimensions.assessment: Directs FTC rulemaking and enforcement, but does not specify federal funding or appropriations amounts.
Establishes a comprehensive new federal regulatory framework for generative AI transparency and safety under the FTC.
dimensions.evidence: A violation of section 4 or 5 or a regulation promulgated under this Act shall be treated as a violation of a rule defining an unfair or deceptive act or practice

dimensions.assessment: Creates ongoing, permanent regulatory and reporting obligations for covered entities.
dimensions.evidence: made available to the public at such time, as determined by the Commission, and on an ongoing basis

missing_information: Specific figures on administrative costs to the federal government or compliance costs for private entities.
importance_detail.rationale: Imposes broad disclosure, reporting, and regulatory requirements on developers and deployers of major artificial intelligence models and systems, enforced by the Federal Trade Commission.
